description: This file defines the TensorFlowImageClassifier class, which implements image classification using TensorFlow inference in an Android environment. It includes methods for initialization, image recognition, and resource management.

classes.name: TensorFlowImageClassifier
classes.description: A class to perform image classification tasks using TensorFlow inference within an Android app, supporting loading model and label files, processing images, and returning classification results.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to initialize and set up the classifier with model and label files, including pre-allocating buffers and retrieving output layer size.

methods.name: recognizeImage
methods.description: Performs image recognition on a given Bitmap, preprocessing the image, running inference, and returning top classifications.

methods.name: enableStatLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables statistical logging during inference.

methods.name: getStatString
methods.description: Returns statistical information about inference performance.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the inference interface and releases resources.
